name: kimono-rag-mcp
description: Local RAG for code and documentation with lexical and semantic search over MCP.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Kimono requires a trusted workspace before starting a knowledge server.

kimono.logLevel.description: Errors only by default, without trace files. Debug enables detailed stderr diagnostics; native diagnostics are rate-limited per operation. The host controls log retention.

enumDescriptions: Default. Static models: Potion code for code, Potion multilingual for documents.
Potion code for code, bundled multilingual E5 for documents.
Bundled multilingual E5 for every file.
Your choice: kimono.embeddingCodeModel for code, kimono.embeddingDocumentsModel for documents.
kimono.embeddingPolicy.description: Initial embedded-server embedding policy only. The server's saved per-root policy takes precedence. Change active policy with confirmation in the Kimono panel. Remote servers ignore this local setting; downloads always require separate consent.

enumDescriptions: Jina v2 base code (161M, 30 programming languages)
kimono.embeddingCodeModel.markdownDescription: Model for code files when `kimono.embeddingPolicy` is `custom` (initial value; the panel choice saved per ROOT takes precedence). Downloads need consent in the Kimono panel.

enumDescriptions: Jina v2 base code (161M, 30 programming languages)
kimono.embeddingDocumentsModel.markdownDescription: Model for documents when `kimono.embeddingPolicy` is `custom` (initial value; the panel choice saved per ROOT takes precedence). Downloads need consent in the Kimono panel.

enumDescriptions: Default. One snapshot per prompt: begin reuses your live snapshot while searches keep coming, so swarms and delegated agents share one corpus; it closes by itself once idle.
One snapshot for the whole server session (until its lifetime ends).
Legacy: every begin captures a new snapshot and every end closes it.
kimono.snapshotScope.markdownDescription: How long one research snapshot serves you. In `prompt` and `session`, `end` only releases the snapshot; it is always closed once idle.

kimono.snapshotIdleSeconds.markdownDescription: Prompt scope: idle time after which a released snapshot closes and the next begin captures a fresh one.

kimono.semanticDevice.description: Auto benchmarks CPU and available CUDA/CoreML providers once per local server session and selects the fastest measured embedding provider. Explicit providers fail if unavailable. An ONNX runtime with the requested provider is required.

kimono.semanticCpuPercent.description: Per-process automatic CPU budget, respecting the host/container CPU allocation. Not a hard CPU utilization limit.

kimono.semanticMemoryPercent.description: Percentage of currently available host/container RAM used to plan model sessions and batches. Estimates are not a hard memory limit or a GPU VRAM budget.

kimono.semanticWorkers.description: Parallel CPU model sessions. 0 = size to CPU and memory budgets. Accelerators use one session.

kimono.semanticThreads.description: ONNX inference threads. 0 = one thread per CPU session, using independent workers for parallelism.

kimono.semanticBatch.description: Passages per embedding batch. 0 = size to available RAM after accounting for model sessions.

kimono.corpusMode.description: RAG (default) indexes source code and documentation locally. Select aikido only for a compatible knowledge base with an index entry point. Both modes respect .gitignore and dependency/build exclusions.

path.description: Repository directory relative to the Kimono ROOT ("" = ROOT).

kimono.repositories.markdownDescription: Independent Git repositories inside the ROOT (for example a sub-project ignored by the parent `.gitignore`). Each declared repository is indexed under its own ignore rules and can be selected with the `repository` search filter. Paths are relative to the ROOT, without `..`.

kimono.configFile.description: Absolute path to a host-controlled corpus JSON config (extensions, filenames, include/exclude globs, limits and nested Git `repositories`). Never auto-loaded from a project. corpusMode overrides its mode; kimono.repositories is added to its repositories.

kimono.mode.description: Embedded uses the bundled local server. Remote connects to an existing HTTP MCP. Disabled removes the definitions.

kimono.root.description: Knowledge directory, absolute or relative to each workspace folder. Empty uses that folder. Caches stay outside it.

kimono.url.description: Remote HTTP MCP endpoint. HTTPS required except localhost. Never put credentials in this URL.

kimono.gitProfileFile.description: Optional absolute path to the current user's private 0600/0400 Git read-profile JSON outside the knowledge root. Never put secrets in settings.

kimono.discoverRepositories.markdownDescription: Automatically declare the independent Git repositories found under the ROOT (up to 3 levels; `node_modules` and hidden folders skipped), in addition to `kimono.repositories`.

kimono.syncMcpJson.markdownDescription: On activation (install and update included), point the Kimono entries of the workspace `.mcp.json` at the version-free launcher and refresh their repositories. Other servers are never touched.
